I have been a Bandolier fan for over 6 years when I had my iPhone X. I originally saw it probably on IG but bought one and have been a fan ever since. The Hailey Side Slot X-Body is the BOMB. I love that the side slot makes it easier to get to your ID, credit cards, etc. You can even stick some folded up cash in there. The quality has improved even more from 6 years ago (and there was nothing to complain about back then). It’s easy to pop in and out and I get compliments ALL THE TIME. Highly recommend. Yes, they’re pricey but super durable and double as a X-Body purse with the long strap. I also have the pouch and AirPod case which I use all the time. You can mix and match straps. LOVE Bandolier!

I was pleased to receive several prompt email responses from customer service when I had some questions prior to purchasing. I decided on the Hailey crossbody and I love it. After receiving my item, a wonderful customer service person made it really easy for me to exchange it after I mistakenly ordered the wrong size. A great experience all around.
